entities.name: Ifnir
entities.description: A desolate region of the Broken Lands desert where the God-Pharaoh cast out rebellious demons.

entities.name: God-Pharaoh
entities.description: Ruler who banished the rebellious demons; actually Nicol Bolas's persona.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Hidden master of Amonkhet's demons and angels.

entities.name: Demons of Amonkhet
entities.description: Demons that prowl the desert and serve Bolas.

events.summary: The God-Pharaoh casts the plane's demons out to the Ifnir wasteland as punishment for defiance.
events.quote: the God-Pharaoh cast out all the plane's demons to this wasteland as punishment for daring to defy him

relations.quote: are under the hidden dominion of Nicol Bolas
